description: §18.5 block-body arm in a derived cell (§6.6) recomputes on upstream change. Raising @level Low -> High recomputes @label from the .Low block arm ({ const c = "green"; c }) to the .High block arm ({ const c = "red"; c }) — the block arm's TAIL expression is the derived value, and the derived cell recomputes when its scrutinee @level changes.
rationale: §18.5 block-arm tail lift composes with §6.6 derived reactivity and markup-interpolation reactivity: the arm value is the block's tail expression, and the derived / interpolation recomputes when its scrutinee (@level) changes. High -> label "red", markup "gray".
